visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of an open manga book featuring hand-drawn sketches of characters and maps, accompanied by handwritten Japanese annotations. A hand reaches in and turns the page, revealing a chapter title written in large Traditional Chinese characters about events in July 2025. The lighting is focused and warm on the paper. (2) Medium shot of a man with long, unkempt black hair and a multi-colored striped t-shirt. He is holding the manga book, looking intently at the pages. He looks up from the book, his expression shifting from curiosity to a thoughtful, slightly concerned gaze into the distance. (3) Close-up of a circular digital alarm clock with a red silicone cover. The screen displays 7/4 Fri and the time 23:59 with a pixelated Mario sprite character at the bottom. The time then updates to 7/5 Sat 00:00, signifying the transition to the next day. (4) Return to the man as he continues to hold the book. He looks up at the ceiling and then glances around the room with wide eyes, appearing to check his surroundings for any unusual occurrences after the clock struck midnight. He looks slightly tense and expectant. (5) A wider shot shows the man sitting on a blue couch. Behind him is a white wall decorated with several colorful plush toys, including a pink Patrick Star and a green Godzilla. He holds the book in his lap while looking around the room nervously. (6) Close-up focus on the man's face. He looks up once more, letting out a deep, audible sigh of relief or perhaps disappointment as nothing happens. He eventually lowers his head back down to continue reading the manga, his expression neutralizing. (7) Final close-up of the book's interior pages, showing the same manga illustrations and text as seen earlier, reinforcing the source of his concern.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-frequency, tense ambient synthesizer drone that sets a mysterious atmosphere. A distinct, crisp sound of paper rustling is heard as a book page is flipped, followed by the quiet room tone of an indoor space. No voices are present. (2) The low synthesizer drone continues at a steady volume, creating a sense of suspenseful anticipation. The acoustic texture is clean, with very little background noise, focusing the listener's attention on the subtle musical undercurrent. The tempo remains slow and atmospheric. (3) A sharp, short electronic click sound occurs precisely as the digital clock display changes from 23:59 to 00:00. The synthesizer drone remains constant in the background, maintaining the established mood of mystery. There is no shift in pitch or loudness during this phase. (4) The ambient drone persists, characterized by a dark and slightly ominous tonal quality. No vocal information is captured, but the stillness of the environment is punctuated by very faint incidental sounds of movement, likely from the person sitting on the couch. (5) A soft, audible exhaled sigh is heard, representing the only human-produced sound. The synthesizer music begins to fade out slightly as the tension breaks. The overall loudness remains moderate, with the ambient drone eventually tapering off into a studio-silent floor.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video parodies or dramatizes the anxiety surrounding a real-world prophecy from the manga 'The Future as I See It' by Tatsuki, which predicted a catastrophe in July 2025. It shows the protagonist waiting for the clock to strike midnight on a significant date, followed by relief when nothing happens.
